decision.explanation: The question asks how many buildings are included in the Danville Historic District. Multiple documents provide conflicting counts of contributing buildings, each tied to different versions or locations of the Danville Historic District. Document D1S2 and D2S2 state 291 contributing buildings, D3S2 and D4S2 state 150, D5S2 and D6S1 state 48, and D8S2 and D9S2 state 272. These numbers refer to different districts (Pennsylvania vs. Virginia) or different times (e.g., 1973). Since the question does not specify location or time, all valid counts from the provided sources are preserved.
